source_findings: Architecture is layered: eBPF programs -> JSON stdout -> native capture/event streams -> pluggable analyzers/materialized view -> SQLite/OTel/output/web.

eBPF programs include SSL/TLS uprobes, process lifecycle tracing and stdio capture; capture runners normalize events and can also ingest agent-native session files, /proc snapshots and saved SQLite databases.
The CLI supports top, monitor, record, report and debug modes; report can query saved local SQLite sessions without live eBPF attachment.

Live eBPF capture requires elevated privileges (sudo or CAP_BPF plus CAP_SYS_ADMIN) and Linux-specific instrumentation; binary resolution and statically linked SSL/BoringSSL create explicit capture failure modes.
The Rust collector uses bundled rusqlite plus async/runtime/web dependencies; therefore full import is materially heavier than a narrow adapter or offline witness importer.

thin_integration_shape: Prefer AgentSight as an out-of-process measurement witness during bounded characterization/failure experiments.
Import only typed, provenance-bound witness records or OTLP/SQLite-derived summaries into F2 telemetry; preserve original AgentSight database/report hashes as external evidence references.
Keep UnifiedDB authoritative; AgentSight SQLite remains a derived measurement artifact.

Use non-privileged saved-session/report surfaces when they answer the question; escalate to privileged eBPF only when independent OS-level process/file/network/TLS evidence has positive information gain.
Do not couple AgentSight frontend/web server into the minimal F2 cognitive kernel.

hypothesis: AgentSight can add independent OS-level observability that catches process/file/network/TLS effects missed by self-reported F2 telemetry and materially improves F2-WP-902/F2-WP-904 root-cause evidence.
counterhypotheses: F2-native telemetry plus direct OS profilers may cover the same discriminators with less privilege, dependency and operational overhead.
TLS uprobes can miss or misattribute traffic for stripped/static runtimes or thread-name filtering edge cases, reducing witness reliability.
Root/CAP_BPF/CAP_SYS_ADMIN requirements may make the strongest AgentSight mode unsuitable as a permanent production dependency.
AgentSight-derived session reconstruction may correlate with F2 events without proving canonical causal identity unless F2 supplies explicit run/trace/effect bindings.
acceptance_falsifiers_for_next_stage: On one exact F2 workload, compare F2-native telemetry vs AgentSight witness for process tree, file effects, network destinations, token/LLM spans and latency; count independently observed/missed/misattributed events.
Measure p50/p95/p99 latency and CPU/RSS/I/O overhead with AgentSight OFF vs non-privileged session/report mode vs privileged eBPF record mode.
Inject known child-process/file/network effects and verify that AgentSight evidence binds to immutable F2 run_id/trace_id/effect_id without becoming a second authority.
Verify fail-open observational behavior: AgentSight absence/failure must not block F2 cognition/effects unless a specific test explicitly requires the witness.
Reject promotion if the same diagnostic information is obtainable more cheaply and deterministically from F2-native telemetry or narrower standard tools.
